scenario: Alterion 技术面,面试官问一个计数器被很多线程同时更新,为什么会突然变慢。她想说「锁被抢得很凶,线程只能排队,吞吐就掉下来了」,却只憋出「too many people use it at the same time」。
scenario_en: In the Alterion technical round, asked why a counter hammered by many threads suddenly slows down, she wants to say the lock is contended so threads serialize and throughput tanks, but only manages 'too many people use it at the same time.'
q: 想说「锁竞争激烈,线程只能排队执行,吞吐量就掉下来了」,该怎么说出口?
q_en: How do you say 'the lock is contended, so threads serialize and throughput tanks'?
options: Too many people use it at the same time, so it get very slow because they wait wait for their turn.
So so the lock, the lock is like, a lot of threads want it, want it, and they they wait and wait and it's slow.
The lock is contended, so threads serialize and throughput tanks.
Elevated contention on the synchronization primitive compels threads to execute sequentially, thereby diminishing throughput.
tradeoff: 地道术语 lock contention + serialize vs 大白话「too many people」:前者一句话点出锁竞争和它对吞吐的影响,后者听不出你懂机制。
why: 术语是 lock contention,配 serialize 和 tanks——一句话把锁被抢、排队、吞吐下降说清了。
why_en: The term is lock contention — 'serialize' and 'tanks' name the mechanism, not just the symptom.
whenOtherWins: 如果锁粒度已经很细、争用很轻,说 'contention here is negligible' 也够。
options_en: Too many people use it at the same time, so it get very slow because they wait wait for their turn.
So so the lock, the lock is like, a lot of threads want it, want it, and they they wait and wait and it's slow.
The lock is contended, so threads serialize and throughput tanks.
Elevated contention on the synchronization primitive compels threads to execute sequentially, thereby diminishing throughput.
optionMeanings: 她的原话:「too many people」,没有术语也没机制。
反复「so so、want it」却没落到术语。
地道:contention + serialize + tanks,机制一句到位。
教科书腔:念 primitive、thereby 这类书面词。
optionMeanings_en: Her actual line: 'too many people,' no term, no mechanism.
Loops on 'so so, want it, wait and wait,' never lands the term.
Idiomatic: contention plus serialize plus tanks, one clean line.
optionScenarioImpacts: 对方听不出你懂锁竞争,以为只是模糊感觉。
对方等那个词,你却一直卡在描述里。
一句话点出竞争和吞吐后果,面试官点头。
太书面,像背的,显不出你真调过锁。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: They can't tell you grasp contention; sounds like a vague feeling.
They wait for the term while you circle the description.
One line names the contention and its throughput hit; they nod.
Too bookish; hides that you've actually tuned a lock.
optionDirectness: 错在粒度:没说 contention,机制没露。
错在时机:面试当场绕圈,丢掉主动权。
抓住 contention + serialize 的因果链。
错在语域:口语面试不用 primitive/thereby。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong grain: no 'contention', mechanism stays hidden.
Wrong timing: circling live loses the floor.
Nails it: contention plus the serialize-then-tanks chain.

termDefinitions.meaning: 锁竞争:多个线程同时想拿同一把锁,拿不到的只能排队等待。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Lock contention is when multiple threads want the same lock at once, and the losers have to wait in line.

termDefinitions.meaning: 本来能并发的操作,因为都在等同一把锁,被迫变成一个接一个顺序执行。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: To serialize is to force operations that could run concurrently into one-at-a-time execution because they're waiting on the same lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统单位时间内能处理完成的请求数量;锁竞争严重时会明显下降。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Throughput is how many requests the system completes per unit time; heavy contention drags it down.

scenario: 系统设计追问并发:两个请求同时给同一个余额加钱。她想指出这里有竞态,却只憋出「两个东西同时发生就乱了」,说不出那个词。
scenario_en: A system-design follow-up: two requests add to the same balance at once. She wants to flag a race condition but only gets out 'two things happen at once and it breaks,' missing the term.
q: 想说「检查和写入之间有竞态,两个请求都读到旧值再各自写」,怎么说地道?
q_en: How do you say 'there's a race between the check and the write — both read the old value, then both write'?
options: There's a race between the check and the write — both requests read the old value, then both update.
Two things happen at the same time and it kind of messes up the data.
So when the, when two requests come in in parallel, they they sort of step on each other and the number gets, gets wrong somehow.
A concurrency anomaly arises due to simultaneous access to the shared counter.
tradeoff: 术语 race + check/write vs 泛泛描述:「a race between the check and the write」点名机制;「同时就乱了」听不出你懂在哪。
why: 说 race condition 并点到「check 和 write 之间」——两个请求都读到旧值再各自写。定位到冲突窗口,才证明你懂机制而非只知词。
why_en: Name the race condition and pin it to the check-then-write window where both read the old value.
whenOtherWins: 只有对非技术听众解释时,「two updates collide」这种大白话反而更好懂。
options_en: There's a race between the check and the write — both requests read the old value, then both update.
Two things happen at the same time and it kind of messes up the data.
So when the, when two requests come in in parallel, they they sort of step on each other and the number gets, gets wrong somehow.
A concurrency anomaly arises due to simultaneous access to the shared counter.
optionMeanings: 地道:说 race,并锁定 check 与 write 之间的窗口。
她的原话:只说「两个东西同时发生就乱了」。
绕「in in、they they」却没说出 race。
optionMeanings_en: Idiomatic: names the race and pins the check-to-write window.
Her line: just 'two things at once and it messes up.'
Loops on 'in in, they they', never says race.
optionScenarioImpacts: 一句话定位冲突窗口,面试官知道你懂并发。
对方听不出你懂问题在哪,追问会更狠。
当场卡壳绕圈,像临时才想到这回事。
太书面像背定义,显不出实战判断。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: One line locates the window; they see you grasp concurrency.
They can't tell you know where the bug is; they'll dig harder.
Stalling live sounds like you just thought of it.
Too bookish; hides real hands-on judgment.
optionDirectness: 抓住关键差异:race + 具体到 check/write 的窗口。
错在粒度:没说出 race,也没定位窗口。
错在时机:面试当场绕圈丢掉主动权。
错在语域:口语面试不用 anomaly 这种词。
optionDirectness_en: Nails it: 'race' plus the specific check/write window.
Wrong grain: no 'race', no window located.
Wrong timing: circling live loses the floor.
Wrong register: 'anomaly' isn't how you'd speak it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个并发操作交叉执行,结果取决于谁先谁后,导致数据出错。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A race condition is when two concurrent operations interleave and the outcome depends on their timing, corrupting the result.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先读/检查一个值再据此写回;两步之间是竞态的高发窗口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Check-then-write means you read a value, then write based on it — the gap between the two steps is where races happen.

scenario: 高并发面试:面试官问怎么防止两个人同时改同一行。她想说「用乐观锁,靠版本号」,却只憋出「add a lock」,说不清乐观在哪。
scenario_en: High-concurrency round: how do you stop two people writing the same row at once? She wants 'optimistic locking with a version number' but only manages 'add a lock,' unable to say what's optimistic.
q: 想说「用乐观锁——加版本号,写入时版本对不上就拒绝」,怎么说出口?
q_en: How do you say 'use optimistic locking — bump a version and reject the write if the version doesn't match'?
options: I would just add a lock so that two writes don't, don't happen together on the row.
So we we can maybe have some kind of, of versioning thing where if the version is, is not the same we don't let it write.
Employ an optimistic concurrency-control mechanism utilizing version-based conflict detection.
Use optimistic locking — bump a version number and reject the write if the version is stale.
tradeoff: 乐观锁 vs 悲观锁:optimistic 靠版本号在提交时查冲突、不阻塞读;pessimistic 直接上锁但吞吐低。说清「optimistic」才显你懂取舍。
why: 说 optimistic locking,并点出机制:加版本号、版本不对就拒绝。这区别于悲观加锁,证明你懂并发控制的取舍。
why_en: Say optimistic locking and spell out the mechanism — bump a version and reject the write when it's stale.
whenOtherWins: 写冲突极频繁、重试代价高时,悲观锁(直接锁行)反而更省事,这时说 'take a row lock' 才对。
options_en: I would just add a lock so that two writes don't, don't happen together on the row.
So we we can maybe have some kind of, of versioning thing where if the version is, is not the same we don't let it write.
Employ an optimistic concurrency-control mechanism utilizing version-based conflict detection.
Use optimistic locking — bump a version number and reject the write if the version is stale.
optionMeanings: 她的原话:只说「add a lock」,说不出乐观还是悲观。
绕「we we、of of」在描述版本号却没说出术语。
地道:说对乐观锁,带上版本号并拒绝旧写。
optionMeanings_en: Her line: just 'add a lock', can't say optimistic vs pessimistic.
Loops on 'we we, of of', describes versioning but no term.
Idiomatic: says optimistic locking, version + reject stale write.
optionScenarioImpacts: 面试官不知你指哪种锁,以为你没想清取舍。
对方等那个词,你却卡在描述里绕。
太书面像背的,显不出你真做过并发控制。
一句话点清乐观锁机制,面试官知道你懂取舍。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: They can't tell which lock you mean; the tradeoff looks fuzzy.
They wait for the term while you circle the description.
Too bookish; hides that you've built concurrency control.
One line names the optimistic mechanism; the tradeoff lands.
optionDirectness: 错在粒度:「a lock」没区分乐观/悲观,取舍丢了。
错在时机:描述半天没说出那个术语。
错在语域:口语面试不用 employ/utilizing。
抓住关键差异:optimistic + 版本号在提交时查冲突。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong grain: 'a lock' hides optimistic vs pessimistic.
Nails it: optimistic + version checked at commit time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 乐观并发控制:不上锁,写入时比对版本号,版本变了就拒绝并让调用方重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Optimistic locking takes no lock; it compares a version number at write time and rejects the write if the version changed, asking the caller to retry.

termDefinitions.meaning: 悲观锁:先锁住行再改,阻塞其他写;吞吐低但冲突多时更简单。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pessimistic locking takes a row lock before writing, blocking other writers — lower throughput but simpler when conflicts are frequent.

termDefinitions.meaning: 行上的一个计数器,每次写自增;写入时版本对不上说明有人先改了。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A version number is a counter on the row that increments each write; a mismatch at write time means someone updated it first.

scenario: 面试官问支付接口:用户双击提交或客户端重试,会不会重复扣款。她想说「加幂等键,重复请求就是 no-op」,但绕来绕去说不利落。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: if a user double-clicks submit or the client retries, does the payment charge twice? She wants 'add an idempotency key so a duplicate is a no-op' but rambles.
q: 想说「给写操作加幂等键,重复请求就是 no-op」,怎么说出口?
q_en: How do you say 'make the write idempotent with an idempotency key so a duplicate is a no-op'?
options: We make it so that if the retry happens, it doesn't do the thing twice by accident.
Make the write idempotent with an idempotency key so a retry or double-submit is a no-op.
So so we want to make sure that when the same request comes, comes again, we don't charge them, charge them twice.
The endpoint shall guarantee idempotence such that duplicate invocations produce identical state.
tradeoff: 术语 idempotent + idempotency key vs 大白话绕圈:一个词点清机制;「不小心做两次」听不出你会怎么实现。
why: 说 idempotent 并带上 idempotency key:同一 key 的重复请求是 no-op,证明你会落地防重。
why_en: Say idempotent and name the idempotency key so a duplicate request is a no-op.
whenOtherWins: 对非技术同事,说 a retry won't double-charge 这种大白话反而更好懂。
options_en: We make it so that if the retry happens, it doesn't do the thing twice by accident.
Make the write idempotent with an idempotency key so a retry or double-submit is a no-op.
So so we want to make sure that when the same request comes, comes again, we don't charge them, charge them twice.
The endpoint shall guarantee idempotence such that duplicate invocations produce identical state.
optionMeanings: 她的原话:「不小心做两次」,没说出术语和机制。
地道:术语齐,给请求配 key,重复即空操作。
绕「so so、comes comes」在复述场景没落到术语。
optionMeanings_en: Her line: 'doesn't do it twice by accident', no term or mechanism.
Idiomatic: idempotent + idempotency key, duplicate is a no-op.
Loops on 'so so, comes comes', retells the scene, no term.
optionScenarioImpacts: 面试官不知你怎么实现防重,以为只有模糊想法。
一句话给出术语和落地机制,面试官放心。
当场绕圈,像还没想好做法。
太书面像背的,显不出你真写过这接口。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: They can't tell how you'd dedupe; it sounds like a vague idea.
One line gives the term and the mechanism; they're reassured.
Circling live sounds like you haven't figured it out.
Too bookish; hides that you've built this endpoint.
optionDirectness: 错在粒度:没说 idempotent,也没提 key,机制缺失。
抓住关键差异:idempotent + key 让重复请求成 no-op。
错在时机:面试当场绕圈丢掉主动权。
错在语域:口语面试不用 shall/invocations。
optionDirectness_en: Wrong grain: no 'idempotent', no key, mechanism missing.
Nails it: idempotent + key makes the duplicate a no-op.
Wrong timing: circling live loses the floor.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一操作执行一次和执行多次效果相同;重复请求不会造成额外副作用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Idempotent means running the operation once or many times has the same effect — duplicates cause no extra side effect.

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端给每个请求带的唯一 key,服务端记下已处理的 key,重复到达就直接返回原结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotency key is a unique id the client attaches to a request; the server records processed keys and returns the original result on a duplicate.

termDefinitions.meaning: no operation,不产生任何状态变化的空操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A no-op is a call that does nothing and changes no state.
